title: D3D12 causes black screen, screen tearing and visual glitches on Intel Celeron N4500 (Jasper Lake) in 4.6
body:
### Tested versions

Godot 4.6 stable — bug is present
Godot 4.5 stable — bug is NOT present (D3D12 was not the default, Vulkan was used instead)



### System information

Godot v4.6.1.stable - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Mobile) - integrated Intel(R) HD Graphics Gen11 - Intel(R) Celeron(R) N4500 @ 1.10GHz (2 threads) - 3.77 GiB memory

### Issue description

Intel Celeron N4500 (Jasper Lake) supports DirectX 12 natively. In Godot 4.6, D3D12 performs significantly better than Vulkan on this hardware (60+ fps vs 40fps), however D3D12 causes severe visual glitches including random black screens, screen tearing, blur and shaking even on a blank scene. Vulkan has no visual issues but is noticeably slower, making it an unsatisfactory workaround.

### Steps to reproduce

Open Godot 4.6 on a machine with Intel Celeron N4500 (Jasper Lake)
Create a new project with Mobile renderer
Ensure rendering driver is set to D3D12 (default in 4.6)
Open any scene including a blank one
Observe random black screens, screen tearing, blur and screen shaking affecting the entire display when navigating the godot inferface and sometimes idle
